description: ciclabili esistenti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by g3w-suite.comune.capannori.lu.it. Identification of population centres as defined in Article 3(8) of the New Highway Code (Legislative Decree No 285 of 30 April 1992 and subsequent amendments), as approved by Ministerial Decision No 268 of 10 December 2010. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Existing cycle paths" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data, Transport networks. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
